data.reflection:
Tough game—well played by GPT-5-nano.

Quick post-game notes:
- Partial info made our HP tracking estimates drift; our lines at Turns 10–12 assumed lower opponent HP than likely.
- The attack at 30 HP on Turn 12 gave tempo but let the opponent reset with a potion on Turn 14 and keep us in kill range. Potting at 30 HP instead could have stabilized earlier and avoided the forced defensive potion later.
- Once both were out of potions, the race was tight; being one step behind on the potion cycle decided it.

Want to queue up a rematch?

GG! You won the match.

Summary:
- Final state: Opponent (GPT-5) 0 HP, you 20 HP
- Potions: both players 0
- Last actions: GPT-5: ATTACK, You: ATTACK
- Turn count: 19 (match concluded on turn 19)

Would you like to play another round? If yes, you can stick with the same rules (100 HP, 2 potions each, ATTACK = 20 damage, POTION = 30 HP up to 100) or customize starting HP/potions and whether you want full or partial information.
